delivery.outcome: The planfile queue no longer stalls behind human-executor tickets. parse_next_ticket in non-interactive mode serves llm/shell/api tickets first and returns a human ticket (waiting_input) only when nothing else is runnable; interactive mode is unchanged. Tickets without executor.kind defer like human tickets.
nonGoals: no changes to the drain loop or runner execution semantics
no new statuses; waiting_input still terminates the loop when only human tickets remain

architecture.decision: parse_next_ticket partitions eligible tickets by executor kind in non-interactive mode; _is_human_executor mirrors _resolve_executor_kind so missing/empty kind counts as human

validation.evidence: human tickets defer behind runnable work non-interactively; waiting_input is reached only when no machine work remains
